summary: Mount NFS backup repositories nosuid,nodev,noexec, matching SMB3 backup mounts; VM storage NFS mounts are unchanged. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The NFS and SMB3 prerequisites now state the data-only mount options Core uses.

api.reason: Mount options are chosen by Core when it writes its own mount unit. No route, payload, permission or result change.

roadmap.reason: Hardens an existing destination in the current slice.

state.reason: No new durable record. The mount unit is regenerated from the master's repository registration, which a fresh Controller adopts as before.

verification.method: TestNFSBackupMountIsDataOnlyAndVMStorageMountIsNot failed with the previous managed_backup.go through go test -overlay and passes now; go test -count=1 -run 'NFS|Remote|Mount|Backup|Storage' ./internal/vmhost/ passed.
verification.limits: Unit fixture only; no real NFS mount, lab or forge CI run. A lab NFS backup unit written before this change must be detached once before Core prepares it again.
